categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Rehearsal Hall
categories.info: Rehearsal Halls are large-scale challenges that focus on a specific Bananza form. They can only be accessed after finishing the story.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Transition
categories.info: Transitions are Blast Barrel passageways between Sublayers

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

**Location:** Inside the snow zebra.

locations.description:
**Location:** Buried in the snow near the doorway. Can only be entered after breaking a void machine in the yellow-and-blue ice cream hut nearby.

**Opponents:** Crockoid x6

**Reward:** [15 - Battle: Quick Quake Quarrel](#loc=468932)

locations.description:
**Location:** At the end of a walkway inside the cave. Watch out for icicles as you approach.

**Opponents:** Antickoid x5

**Reward:** [26 - Battle: Barely Skating By](#loc=468940)

locations.description:

_Tip: Turf Surf over the lava, then clap to quickly dismount!_

locations.description:

**Opponents:** Squeeloid x8

**Reward:** [78 - Battle: Fighting on the Run](#loc=469075)

locations.description:
**Location:** On the island.

**Strategy:** Turf Surf over the lava - and ice, if it's giving you trouble. It's also worth purchasing the [Floating Chocolava Lake Getaway](#loc=468989) for a close fast travel point.
